Bomb Threat Turns Routine European Flight Into a Security Drama

A routine flight from London to Sofia suddenly turned into a scene passengers probably never expected to experience. A Wizz Air Airbus A321neo was forced to divert to Budapest, Hungary, after receiving a bomb threat midair. 

Hungarian authorities took no chances and scrambled a Gripen fighter jet to escort the passenger aircraft through the country’s airspace. 

The plane landed safely, but emergency crews, police and counterterrorism officers were already waiting. Not exactly the Budapest stopover anyone had booked.
